description: Generate a slide deck from a brief and iterate against two evaluators — accessibility on slides (AA with large-text thresholds, scope:deck) and deck quality (penpot-build-deck references/07-critique-framework.md + the structural gate) — until both gates pass; when the user opted in to strict anti-slop mode (prefs.antiSlop, asked once at Phase 0), a third evaluator — penpot-anti-slop diagnose — must score ≤ 35.
exit: AA pass on slides (no High/Medium) AND deck-quality pass (no axis < 3, structural gate pass) AND (strict mode off OR slop score ≤ 35) OR maxIterations reached -> present remaining issues + weak axes + unlinked slides
output: report: { deckPageId, slideCount, flowName, iterations, finalA11y, finalDeckQuality, finalSlop? }
